# vpsie_migration_sources (Data Source)

Lists the account's Migrate sources. Credentials are never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vpsie_migration_sources" "vcenter" {
  type = "vmware-vcenter"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `type` (String) Only sources of this type, for example `vmware-vcenter`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `sources` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sources))

<a id="nestedatt--sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sources`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the source was created (RFC 3339).
- `datacenter_identifier` (String) The datacenter whose nodes run the source's jobs.
- `host` (String) The host the source connects to.
- `identifier` (String) The source identifier.
- `name` (String) The source name.
- `status` (String) The source status.
- `type` (String) The source type.
- `username` (String) The user the source signs in as.
